title: Death Crimson
overview:
Virtua Gun Compatible - The Evolving Gun

Guided by "Crimson," Combat Echizen shoots down the creatures that attack him. What is the mysterious gun "Crimson," the gun that evolves! Breathless monster attacks in a beautiful 3DCG world that flows throughout the entire game - can you evolve your gun? And can you defeat the enemy?!

バーチャガン対応・進化する銃

"クリムゾン"に導かれたコンバット越前が、襲ってくるクリーチャーを撃つ。謎の銃"クリムゾン"進化する銃とは!全篇流れる美しい3DCGの世界に息もつかせぬ魔物の襲撃、君は銃を進化させられるか? そして敵を倒すことができるか?!
